title: LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy — Schedule of Forms, Perils and Settlement Basis
content:
The LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy is written in six tiers on three ISO dwelling forms. Each tier fixes the peril basis for the rental building, how the building and the landlord's furnishings and appliances are settled, whether theft of those furnishings is covered, and the two roof figures that decide how roof surfacing is paid.

## Schedule

| | DP-1 Basic | DP-2 Broad | DP-3 Special | DP-3 Special Plus | DP-3 Premier | DP-3 Portfolio |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Dwelling form | DP-1 | DP-2 | DP-3 | DP-3 | DP-3 | DP-3 |
| Peril basis for the dwelling | basic named perils | broad named perils | open perils | open perils | open perils | open perils |
| Dwelling loss settlement | actual cash value | replacement cost | replacement cost | replacement cost | replacement cost | replacement cost |
| Landlord's furnishings and appliances settlement | actual cash value | actual cash value | actual cash value | replacement cost | replacement cost | replacement cost |
| Theft of landlord's furnishings and appliances covered | no | no | no | yes | yes | yes |
| Oldest roof (years at the term effective date) still settling roof surfacing at replacement cost | 0 (never) | 12 | 15 | 15 | 18 | 20 |
| Floor of the roof surfacing payment schedule for the oldest roofs (percent of replacement cost) | 25 | 25 | 30 | 30 | 35 | 35 |

## Reading the roof rows

- The roof replacement-cost age is compared with the roof's age at the term effective date. A figure of 0, as on LandlordGuard DP-1 Basic, means roof surfacing is never settled at replacement cost on that tier.
- The schedule floor is the lowest percentage of replacement cost the roof surfacing payment schedule pays for the oldest roofs on that tier.

## Worked comparisons (hypothetical roofs)

| Hypothetical roof age at the term effective date | DP-2 Broad (limit 12) | DP-3 Premier (limit 18) | DP-3 Portfolio (limit 20) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 12 years | replacement cost | replacement cost | replacement cost |
| 13 years | payment schedule | replacement cost | replacement cost |
| 19 years | payment schedule | payment schedule | replacement cost |

On LandlordGuard DP-1 Basic every roof in the table would be on the payment schedule, because its limit is 0.

## Basis Q&A

**Does any LandlordGuard tier cover theft of the landlord's furnishings and appliances?** Yes: DP-3 Special Plus, DP-3 Premier and DP-3 Portfolio. DP-1 Basic, DP-2 Broad and DP-3 Special do not.

**Which tier settles the dwelling at actual cash value?** Only LandlordGuard DP-1 Basic; every other tier settles the dwelling at replacement cost.
